questions.stem: What does the binomial theorem provide an easier way to do?
choices: Evaluate the numerical values of numbers like (98) and (999) when raised to higher powers
Find the square roots of numbers like (98) and (999) when raised to higher powers
Calculate the cube roots of numbers like (98) and (999) when raised to higher powers
Determine the factors of numbers like (98) and (999) when raised to higher powers
questions.solution: The binomial theorem provides an easier way to expand expressions like (a + b)^n, which is useful for calculating the numerical values of numbers raised to higher powers. This is because repeated multiplication becomes difficult for higher powers, and the theorem offers a systematic approach to expansion. The other options are incorrect because the theorem does not deal with square roots, cube roots, or factors.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about the coefficients in the binomial expansion?
choices: They are the same for all terms
questions.solution: The coefficients in the binomial expansion are determined using combinations, which is a mathematical principle that calculates the number of ways to choose items from a set. The other options are incorrect because coefficients vary depending on the term and the power, and they are not always 1, the same for all terms, or zero.

questions.stem: What is the remainder when 6^n - 5n is divided by 25?
questions.solution: Using the binomial theorem, we expand (1 + 5)^n and find that 6^n - 5n = 25k + 1, which means the remainder is 1. The second option incorrectly assumes the remainder is 5. The third and fourth options are not supported by the expansion.

questions.stem: A random variable X follows the binomial distribution with parameters n and p. If P(X = r) / P(X = n - r) is independent of n and r, what is the value of p?
questions.solution: The probability P(X = r) is given by the binomial formula C(n, r) * p^r * (1 - p)^{n - r}. The ratio P(X = r) / P(X = n - r) simplifies to (p / (1 - p))^{2r - n}. For this ratio to be independent of n and r, the exponent must be zero, which occurs when p = 1/2. The other options do not result in the exponent being zero, so they do not satisfy the condition.

hi.solution: संभाव्यता P(X = r) द्विपद सूत्र C(n, r) * p^r * (1 - p)^{n - r} द्वारा दी जाती है। अनुपात P(X = r) / P(X = n - r) (p / (1 - p))^{2r - n} में सरल हो जाता है। इस अनुपात के n और r से स्वतंत्र होने के लिए, घात शून्य होनी चाहिए, जो p = 1/2 के लिए होता है। अन्य विकल्प घात को शून्य नहीं बनाते हैं, इसलिए वे शर्त को पूरा नहीं करते हैं।

questions.stem: If p is the probability of success in a binomial distribution and P(X = r) = P(X = n - r), what is the value of p?
questions.solution: For a binomial distribution, P(X = r) = P(X = n - r) if and only if p = 1/2. This is because the distribution is symmetric around n/2 when p = 1/2. The other options do not satisfy the symmetry condition of the binomial distribution.
